description: This file defines the TestRun class and various functions to manage and orchestrate test execution phases, including setup, teardown, task creation, and test scheduling within the Playwright testing framework.

classes.name: TestRun
classes.description: Manages the lifecycle and orchestration of a test run, including phases, suites, and failure tracking.

methods.name: runTasks
methods.description: Executes a list of tasks with optional timeout and cancellation, then finalizes the test run.

methods.name: runTasksDeferCleanup
methods.description: Runs tasks with deferred cleanup, then finalizes the test run.

methods.name: finishTaskRun
methods.description: Completes the test run by processing results, invoking reporters, and returning final status.

methods.name: createGlobalSetupTasks
methods.description: Creates setup tasks for global environment initialization.

methods.name: createRunTestsTasks
methods.description: Creates tasks to execute test phases and reporting.

methods.name: createClearCacheTask
methods.description: Creates a task to clear the test cache.

methods.name: createReportBeginTask
methods.description: Creates a task to initialize reporting at the start of a test run.

methods.name: createPluginSetupTasks
methods.description: Creates setup tasks for registered plugins.

methods.name: createPluginBeginTask
methods.description: Creates a task to invoke plugin start hooks.

methods.name: createGlobalSetupTask
methods.description: Creates a global setup task for a specific setup file.

methods.name: createGlobalTeardownTask
methods.description: Creates a global teardown task for a specific teardown file.

methods.name: createRemoveOutputDirsTask
methods.description: Creates a task to remove output directories before tests.

methods.name: createListFilesTask
methods.description: Creates a task to load test files and build test suites.

methods.name: createLoadTask
methods.description: Creates a task to load test files, apply filters, and create test suites.

methods.name: createApplyRebaselinesTask
methods.description: Creates a task to apply rebaselines after tests.

methods.name: createPhasesTask
methods.description: Creates phases for test execution based on project dependencies.

methods.name: createRunTestsTask
methods.description: Creates the main test execution task for all phases.

methods.name: createStartDevServerTask
methods.description: Creates a task to start and stop a development server for testing.
